facts.fact: ICASEES's draft data dissemination policy, validated at a workshop on 24-25 November 2026, is stated to conform to law no. 24.001 on personal data protection, which it applies as existing law.
facts.system: Law no. 24.001 on personal data protection

facts.fact: ICASEES's draft dissemination policy of 24-25 November 2026 is stated to conform to law no. 24.001 on personal data protection, treated as existing law.
facts.system: Law no. 24.001 on personal data protection

CAF.note: The draft policy only says it will align with international norms; no adopted standard, membership or rule is stated.
A statistics office's draft dissemination policy, not adopted and not a national open data policy.

facts.fact: ICASEES says it has run a national open data portal and a NADA microdata catalogue, and its draft policy gives free access to aggregate data and reports.

CAF.note: Civil society and university were only invited to a validation workshop of a statistics dissemination policy; no outside participation on a digital law is stated.

facts.fact: ICASEES's draft dissemination policy, validated 24-25 November 2026, rests on law no. 01.008 of 16 July 2001 organising statistical activity, treated as the existing statistics law.
